name: decay-rules
intro: The 4 built-in decay rules OpenCTI 7.261119.0 creates on first start. All are active, and none can be changed or deleted. To decay some indicators differently, create a rule with a higher order as [Decay rules](/opencti/configure/decay/) explains.

sections.title: Built-in decay rules
sections.text: Among the active rules that match an indicator when it is created, the one with the highest order applies. An indicator is revoked once its score falls to the revoke score; the reaction points are the scores at which OpenCTI updates the score stored on the indicator.

cells: Indicators whose main observable type is Domain name
Indicators whose main observable type is IPv4 address, IPv6 address or URL
Indicators whose main observable type is File or Artifact
Every indicator no other rule matches
